profile_text.body:
AeroVironment Inc describes itself as a leading manufacturer of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, Loitering Munition Systems, and Unmanned Ground Vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States Military, U.S. allies, and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellites. Its MacCready Works advanced development group, named for Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr., includes engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers who design next-generation robotic systems across air, land, and sea.

The company's website does not name specific AI products. It describes MacCready Works as using a method of building fast, testing relentlessly, and deploying advantage to turn concepts into mission-ready autonomous systems. No product names are listed in the available material.

Public records identify AeroVironment Inc as a for-profit public company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, trading under ticker AVAV with SEC Central Index Key 0001368622. The company appears under the names AeroVironment Inc and AEROVIRONMENT INC. Virginia legal records list 152 entries involving the company.
